newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia soars on upgrades, more gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Nokia soars on upgrades, more gains seen.

text.p: Shares in Finnish telecoms major Nokia Oy soared to life-highs on Wednesday, boosted by recent earnings upgrades, brokers said.
At 1425/1125 GMT, Nokia traded at 486.00 markka, up 14.10 markka or 2.99 percent, after hitting an all-time high 488.00 markka -- three markka above its earlier life-high set Monday.
Volume was moderately lively with 345,000 shares traded.
The share suffered a brief bout of profit-taking on Tuesday after reporting slightly above-forecast first-half earnings late on Monday.
"A break through 500 markka is a short-term matter, it can happen this week," one broker said. "By the end of the year, it will be 600 markka," he added.
